content: 2026 free-host comparisons: Cloudflare Pages is the only major free host with no bandwidth cap; GitHub Pages caps free at roughly 100 GB/month; Netlify free tier also ~100 GB and pauses sites when exceeded. GitHub Pages is free for public repos with automatic HTTPS and free custom domain (via DNS); Cloudflare Pages has no build-minutes limits and EU data residency options. All three provide DPAs; for a no-personal-data static site all are GDPR-viable.
